headline: 3 Major Reasons to Buy Coca-Cola Before July 28 Q2 Earnings
summary: Coca-Cola just raised its dividend for the 64th consecutive year and has beaten earnings estimates four quarters in a row, yet most retirement investors are still sleeping on a major catalyst arriving July 28.
